name: LlamaIndex
shortDescription: Open-source framework for retrieval and agents. The cloud free plan includes 10,000 credits.
longDescription: LlamaIndex is aimed at retrieval over your own data, with agent utilities on top of the core library. We installed and imported llama-index-core. On October 16, 2026 the pricing page listed a $0 plan with 10,000 credits and Starter at $50 per month.
pricingNotes: Confirm LlamaCloud tiers on official pricing page before publishing $ amounts.
bestFor: RAG pipelines over documents you already have
Python teams building retrieval into an agent
notIdealFor: Anyone who needs a confirmed free cloud tier
strength: We imported llama-index-core 0.14.25, and the cloud free plan includes 10,000 credits.
weakness: Cloud Starter is $50 per month after the 10,000 free credits.
smokeTestNotes: Install/import only; no API key, no LLM invoke, no signup.

useCaseFit.multi-agent-workflows: Open-source framework for agents that retrieve from documents you provide.
useCaseFit.research-rag: Retrieves passages from documents you provide and can hand them to an agent.
